answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-identity registry: every agent posts a non-transferable stake before transacting, slashed if its behavior diverges from its declared model. Pricing each bond near the cheapest honest operating cost forces a thousand puppets to fund a thousand bonds, erasing the sybil dividend. Hardware attestation gives identities a harbor to dock in, so no sable market of rented accounts forms, while a ridge of auditors samples the ledger for clusters sharing funding and timing.
